payload.title: Cyclotron-web slice 1: prose pages to a Markus publication (Papyrus-web pattern)
payload.description: Follow Papyrus-web/Prospectus-web: Git-authored Markus plus web/projector.py. Prose routes (how-it-works, developers, services, pricing, learn, use-cases, articles) become Markus with directives; the copy-claims, glossary and use-case tests in components/*.test.ts keep guarding wording and must run against the Markus source. Keep every URL. Pictograms and recording charts are islands (slice 2).
